correction_reason: Advance the closed Horo Lite baseline from Phase C to Phase D by freezing the black-box unified reading API endpoint contract for TICKET-HLITE-004.
rationale: Freeze a black-box Phase D unified reading API endpoint baseline for TICKET-HLITE-004. Baseline parent is current HEAD 66937c85b5889807432219a113a1f0302523c074. Red evidence command python3 -m pytest tests/test_horo_lite_unified_reading.py -k test_unified_reading_api_endpoint -v exited actual 1 and expected 1 with fingerprint AssertionError: {"detail":"Not Found"}; assert 404 == 200 because POST /api/v3/unified-reading is not registered in the local FastAPI app. The frozen test uses FastAPI TestClient with TESTING=true and LLM/network toggles disabled, posts the standard 1990-05-15 14:30 Bangkok target_year 2026 request, requires HTTP 200, validates the versioned UnifiedReadingResponse contract, exactly 12 canonical topic modules, exactly 12 monthly scores, 3-5 non-sensitive past patterns, consensus metadata, HITL flags and routing, llm_metadata.facts_mutable_by_llm false, deterministic latency under 300ms when LLM translation is disabled or unavailable, and exact preservation of career/finance/love monthly scores from project.core.annual_timing_engine without out-of-range scores or hallucinated date/fact mutation.
